subject: general
question: A class of boys is standing in only one row. A boy is at thirty third position from both the ends in this sequence. How many boys are there in the class?
solution:
Formula used:

Total number of boys in row = (rank from the left side + rank from the right side) - 1

As per the given information:

A class of boys is standing in only one row. A boy is at the thirty-third position from both ends in this sequence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e17a3a3def35f4068bcca76256d162c0fb966d9cf8f3635f85e1dc793438b91.png] 

Total number of boys in a row = (33 + 33) - 1 = **65**

Hence, the correct answer is "65".
